# The compressed pyramid fixtures, one line per plane: file name, series,
# pixel kind (make.py), plane, rescale intercept, how make.sh encodes it.
# Series 1: one lossless stack in eight syntaxes, a native plane among them.
a0 1 u12 0 -1024 native
a1 1 u12 1 -1024 jpeg-lossless
a2 1 u12 2 -1024 jpeg-lossless-sv1
a3 1 u12 3 -1024 jpeg-ls
a4 1 u12 4 -1024 j2k
a5 1 u12 5 -1024 rle
a6 1 u12 6 -1024 deflate
a7 1 u12 7 -1024 big-endian
# Series 2: signed 16-bit, lossless.
b0 2 s16 0 0 jpeg-lossless-sv1
b1 2 s16 1 0 jpeg-ls
b2 2 s16 2 0 j2k
b3 2 s16 3 0 rle
# Series 3: signed with 12 bits stored, lossless.
c0 3 s12 0 0 native
c1 3 s12 1 0 jpeg-lossless-sv1
c2 3 s12 2 0 jpeg-ls
c3 3 s12 3 0 j2k
# Series 4: 8 bits, lossy.
d0 4 u8 0 0 jpeg-baseline
d1 4 u8 1 0 jpeg-extended
d2 4 u8 2 0 jpeg-ls-near
d3 4 u8 3 0 j2k-lossy
# Series 5: JPEG extended at 12 bits.
e0 5 u12 0 0 jpeg-extended
e1 5 u12 1 0 jpeg-extended
# Series 6: a stack a test breaks one file of.
f0 6 u12 0 0 native
f1 6 u12 1 0 j2k
f2 6 u12 2 0 j2k
